description.text: Program Description English language and literature major trains students to have firm and correct political direction, good moral cultivation, healthy psychological quality. English language and literature professional training practical thick foundation, wide caliber English talents, fluent in listening, speaking, reading, writing, translation and other practical skills, understanding of the English language, literature, and English national historical, social, cultural, political, economic and other knowledge, and has strong practical ability and wide knowledge of humanities and social science culture and preliminary scientific research ability. At the same time, in the second language and the computer aspect has certain application ability. After graduation, I can skillfully use English in teaching, translation, research and management in tourism, foreign affairs, culture, press and publication, education, scientific research and other departments. Duration 3 years

duration.text: The English Language and Literature at Central China Normal University is a 3 Years long program for international students, taught in English.

fees.text: Application Fee: $ 150 USD Service Fee: $ 50 USD Tuition fee: $ 4722 USD/per year ￥ 34000 CNY/per year

materials.text: 1.Photocopy of valid passport With photo, passport number &expiration date and name included. 2.Passport-sized photo A passport-sized photo taken recently of the applicant. 3.Master's degree diploma Graduation certificate should be in Chinese or English.If not, it should be translated into Chinese or English and be notarized. 4.Transcript of postgraduate school 5.Two recommendation letters From professor,associate professor or equivalents.

requirements.text: 1. Applicants must be non-Chinese citizens in good health. 2. Hold a Master's degree.
